resources.string: These are local planning preferences. A saved budget is not a price, cost estimate, notification service or enforced spending limit. Currency is not stored in these fields; review the draft currency separately.
Use non-negative decimal digits, with an optional decimal point and 1–12 digits after it. No sign, grouping separator, currency symbol or exponent. The exact entered amount is retained.
Not supplied, No and Yes are separate choices. This records a preference; the preview does not enforce a spending limit.
Enter a number from 0 through 100, inclusive. Use a decimal point if needed, without a percent sign or grouping separator. This does not create an alert.
Enter a value or clear its Supply checkbox to leave it not supplied.
Enter a valid number with a decimal point if needed; words, decimal commas and percent signs are not accepted.
This input exceeds the existing local editor or numeric parsing limit.

Unfinished input is retained only within the existing local recovery limit. After backgrounding or recreation, review it explicitly before committing. A changed saved draft or an in-flight write keeps recovered input read-only.
